hook: scend＝爬升——一起往上或往下看人。
script: 英雄 ascend 上升，反派 descend 下降；真正高手 transcend 超越階層。最討厭的是 condescend：假裝屈尊下爬來『關心』你。音樂一 crescendo，情緒也往上爬。

members.speakLineEn: She ascended to leadership after the crisis.
members.speakLineZh: 危機後她上升到領導位置。

members.speakLineEn: The debate descended into personal attacks.

members.senseAnchor: be greater in scope or size than some standard; be superior or better than some standard
members.speakLineEn: Great art can transcend its historical moment.
members.speakLineZh: 偉大藝術能超越其歷史時刻。

related.antonyms: be born, fail, failing, running, bottom, side

members.speakLineEn: Do not condescend to readers with oversimplified claims.
members.speakLineZh: 別用過度簡化的說法屈尊俯就讀者。

members.senseAnchor: (music) a gradual increase in loudness; grow louder
members.speakLineEn: Criticism rose to a crescendo before the vote.
members.speakLineZh: 投票前批評聲浪漸強至高潮。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 上升梯: ascent walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「上升梯」出場：ascent 一上場梗就黏住——上升。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 下降梯: descent walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「下降梯」出場：descent 一上場梗就黏住——下降。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 後代牌: descendant walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「後代牌」出場：descendant 一上場梗就黏住——後代。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 俯視鏡: condescending walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「俯視鏡」出場：condescending 一上場梗就黏住——屈尊的。

members.senseAnchor: to increase in extent, amount or scope
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 升級鍵: escalate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「升級鍵」出場：escalate 一上場梗就黏住——升級。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 升天梯: ascension walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「升天梯」出場：ascension 一上場梗就黏住——升天上升。

reviewHooks: 爬：ascend↑ descend↓ transcend 超出去；condescend＝假裝下來
condescend 必帶『高人一等』語氣
pitfalls: descend into = 墮落到某種壞狀態
crescendo 常被誤用為『高潮本身』，嚴格說是『漸強過程』
